decisions.reason: The industrial AC voltage input module still has its own page and fits the push into industrial and energy applications, so holding this option costs little while its demand becomes clearer.
The four-channel solid state relay is a close extension of the relay range and uses shared firmware and production, so keeping it is cheap and nothing so far shows its value is gone.
The server room kit only bundles stocked modules, so keeping it costs almost nothing, though kits are the easiest options to drop if demand stays weak or the platform moves to new connectors.
The RGB LED control module launched only in 2024, so its prospects are still uncertain and the low cost of carrying it justifies keeping the option open.
The wallbox remote access service supports the firm's strategic expansion in charging and energy management, so this young option with growth potential should be held.
